title: The messy middle of career switches nobody posts about
recommended_posting_time: Tuesday Aug 25, 12:00-12:15 PM WAT (lunch scroll, workweek mode)
backup_posting_time: Monday Aug 24, 8:00-8:30 PM WAT (evening reflection scroll)
engagement_window: Be online replying to comments for 90 minutes after posting. Reply to EVERY commenter individually — career-switch posts build your core audience.
primary_cta: Who's in the middle of a switch right now? What's the thing nobody warned you about?
alt_ctas: Tag someone in your network who's mid-switch and needs to read this today.
If you've already made the jump — what's the one thing that finally made you feel like you belonged in the room?

predicted_engagement.comments: Very high — emotional mirror for career switchers (a huge demographic on Nigerian LinkedIn). People share their own in-between stories. Switchers reply with relief. People who made it reply with encouragement.
predicted_engagement.saves: High — people save the 'you don't cross a line' line for bad days.
predicted_engagement.shares: Medium-High — people tag friends who are mid-switch.
predicted_engagement.profile_visits: High — people finding you for the first time from a relatable career post will click through.
predicted_engagement.follows: Strong — this is the post people follow after.

notes: Intentionally does NOT reuse the curiosity/clarity/purpose framework from Post #1. Universal tone — uses med-lab as one example among several, not centering self. Old-career-as-edge framing is the standout line that resonates.
